genetic_variants.effect: D allele homozygous — higher ACE activity, associated with faster CKD progression and LVH
M235T variant — increased angiotensinogen levels, elevated BP risk
Sodium channel variant, borderline reduced conduction velocity
G1 variant carrier — moderate increased CKD risk
*2 allele — intermediate metaboliser, dose adjustment needed for warfarin
Podocin variant contributing to persistent proteinuria

hypertension_prs.interpretation: High genetic risk for essential hypertension. Score indicates 2.8-fold increased risk compared to population median.

ckd_progression_prs.interpretation: Elevated genetic risk for CKD progression. Consistent with advanced stage 4 CKD presentation.

atrial_fibrillation_prs.interpretation: Moderately elevated genetic susceptibility to atrial fibrillation, particularly in context of structural heart disease.

pharmacogenomics.ACE_inhibitor_response: Normal response expected. ACE DD genotype may require higher doses for optimal BP control.
pharmacogenomics.anticoagulant_metabolism: CYP2C9*2 carrier - reduce initial warfarin dose by 25-30%. Monitor INR closely during initiation.
pharmacogenomics.statin_metabolism: Normal metabolism expected. Standard dosing appropriate.
pharmacogenomics.diuretic_response: Good response to thiazide-type diuretics predicted based on genetic profile.

family_history_genetic_notes: Father with CAD and hypertension. Paternal uncle with CKD. Pattern consistent with polygenic cardiovascular-renal risk inheritance.
clinical_summary: 58-year-old South Asian male with advanced CKD stage 4, hypertension, and atrial fibrillation showing genetic predisposition through multiple cardiovascular-renal risk variants. ACE DD genotype and AGT M235T variant contribute to hypertension severity. APOL1 G1 carrier status partially explains CKD progression. SCN5A variant provides genetic context for atrial fibrillation. CYP2C9*2 carrier status requires warfarin dose adjustment. High polygenic risk scores support aggressive cardiovascular risk management and close monitoring of CKD progression.
